notes: A dependency compiled by Babel without the regenerator import, in the shape react-table ships `useAsyncDebounce`: it reads the free `regeneratorRuntime` while rendering, and the captured window has no such global. Declaring react-scripts means `@babel/plugin-transform-runtime` (regenerator: true) rewrites that read into `@babel/runtime/regenerator` in every module it compiles, so the hook must not throw a ReferenceError; vitest runs the untransformed source, so this is asserted statically.
